records.prompt: Use case stylized-concept. Design a POWERFUL NATURAL ARMED RUN of the exact adult white-haired swordsman in reference1, sword in reference2. Two complete figures on transparent requested2560x1440 source sheet, left upright neutral fullbody calibration companion, right newly painted wholebody RUN COMPRESSION pose, facing/travelling screen-right. RUN character leans forward about20degrees FROM ANKLES/HIPS, chest/head ahead of pelvis, eyes level focused forward; do not merely tilt a standing sprite. Near RIGHT leg supports weight: foot lands underneath/just ahead of center of mass, knee bent absorbing impact, pelvis lowered. Far LEFT leg recovering BEHIND, knee deeply folded with heel raised toward buttock, boot clear off ground. Near RIGHT hand firmly holds SINGLE katana low beside and slightly BEHIND the hip, right elbow bent naturally and drawn back, wrist aligned with grip; blade extends BACKWARD screen-left and slightly DOWNWARD well clear of ground and legs. Sharp bright edge is the lower edge, spine upper; do not reverse katana blade or add second weapon. Far LEFT free arm bent ~90degrees and pumping forward chest-height to counterbalance, anatomically attached to far shoulder. Neck/head follow chest naturally, adult compact head unchanged. Coat trails backward screen-left responding to speed, split cloth reveals both thighs and knees; controlled dynamic silhouette, not huge cape. Mature action-game painted art, same black/crimson coat and silver knee plates, wraps on both forearms, long adult legs. No standing upright run, no stiff arms straight forward, no march/high-knee drill, no blur/effects, no scabbard or hip weapon, no text or guide. Keep generous clear space around all hair, boots and sword tip. This is a WHOLE PERSON action study with integrated carry design, intended for later independent weapon layering.
